C01_normal_success_and_live_configuratio.claim: A normal invocation runs the genuine backend in the pinned image, isolated, and removes only its own container.
C01_normal_success_and_live_configuratio.expected: exit 0; pinned image; network none; uid:gid; init; auto-remove; no socket; guard proof backend_exit/0; container absent afterwards
C01_normal_success_and_live_configuratio.failure_hypothesis: Wrong image/user/network, socket exposed, container left behind, or success without backend proof.

C02_wrapper_SIGTERM.claim: Killing a local owner cannot leave an uncontrolled CRISPResso process.
C02_wrapper_SIGTERM.expected: kernel shows no scientific or detached process of that container within 5 s; daemon reports it not running/absent; unrelated containers untouched; wrapper does not report success
C02_wrapper_SIGTERM.failure_hypothesis: After SIGTERM of the wrapper, CRISPResso/fastp (or the detached descendant) keeps running, or the container stays running.

C07_wrapper_frozen_then_killed.claim: A stopped (SIGSTOP) owner still owns its lease; once killed, the backend must stop.
C07_wrapper_frozen_then_killed.expected: backend still alive while owner is frozen; gone within 5 s of SIGKILL
C07_wrapper_frozen_then_killed.failure_hypothesis: Frozen owner loses the kernel lock early, or kill of a stopped owner is not noticed.

C08_owner_lease_file_removed.claim: If the lease can no longer be examined the guard must fail closed.
C08_owner_lease_file_removed.expected: backend gone within 5 s; wrapper non-zero
C08_owner_lease_file_removed.failure_hypothesis: Guard keeps the backend running, or crashes leaving the backend alive.

C09_owner_dies_during_create.claim: A Docker create/start that completes after the owner died can never launch Core.

C09_owner_dies_during_create.failure_hypothesis: Late start runs CRISPResso with no living owner.
